The agent must first locate yellow_concrete and a loom as navigation/orientation landmarks that guide them toward crafting resources. Finding the loom provides contextual proximity to wool-working materials (string/wool nearby). The agent needs to find yellow_concrete which is near the dye supplies (red dye). After locating these landmarks and nearby resources, the agent crafts red_wool (requiring white wool + red dye). Finally, the agent must navigate to find the brick_wall, which is placed beyond the crafting area, requiring the agent to have oriented themselves through the previous tasks. The dependency structure creates a diamond DAG: two parallel exploration tasks converge on crafting, then the final navigation task requires knowledge of the area gained through crafting.
